title: Complexity machine instruction map
statement: For natural numbers $C,e$ and a Boolean mode, define a deterministic instruction map on the states of a finite-register machine. The machine has $14$ registers and $4$ oracle deciders; its instructions are determined by the state, the parameters, and the mode as specified by the transition cases.
caveat: The declaration gives a large case-by-case transition map over a specially constructed state type; the supplied material does not provide informal descriptions of the component state meanings or instruction vocabulary.
